text: Increases the attack power bonus on Windfury Weapon attacks by 80.

Reduces the mana cost of Regrowth by 65.

Increases attack power by 712 in Cat, Bear, Dire Bear, and Moonkin forms only.

Your Judgement ability also increases your shield block value by 186 for 5 sec.
